final_answer: The typical resource requirements for training neural networks include computational power, memory, and data storage. Neurochaos Learning (NL) has shown promise in requiring less computational power and memory compared to traditional deep learning. The success of deep learning is also attributed to the availability of vast amounts of training data and the use of specialized hardware and software, such as GPUs and TensorFlow.
